stem: Based on the ideas presented throughout the selection, what can the reader conclude about jumping and animals?

options.label: A
options.text: Animals need to jump to be able to eat.

options.label: B
options.text: Being able to jump well helps animals in different ways.

options.label: C
options.text: Moving to new places is easy for animals that can jump.

options.label: D
options.text: There are few animals that can jump high.
